humidity.title: How to prevent Anthracnose on Hydrangea Macrophylla
humidity.excerpt: Prolonged or repeated leaf wetness allows fungal and bacterial spores to infect; stagnant and humid conditions slow leaf drying.
humidity.rationale: Source-supported humidity/wetness disease pressure -> conservative medium atmospheric humidity tolerance.

humidity.title: Lavender
humidity.excerpt: Wet, poorly drained soil and high humidity and poor air circulation between plants in the summer lead to the decline of plants.
humidity.rationale: Source-supported high-humidity decline -> conservative low atmospheric humidity tolerance.

humidity.title: Fact sheet: Fig
humidity.excerpt: The humid growing season in Florida is associated with enhanced insect and disease pressure, and rain can cause fruit to split.
humidity.rationale: Species grows in humid regions but humidity increases disease/fruit pressure -> conservative medium.

humidity.institution: Texas A&M AgriLife Extension / Texas Plant Disease Handbook
humidity.title: Lettuce
humidity.excerpt: Cool, humid weather with rain, heavy dew or fog favors downy mildew disease development.
humidity.rationale: Source-supported humid-weather disease pressure -> conservative medium.

morphology.institution: University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture
morphology.title: Leaf Lettuce
morphology.excerpt: Lactuca sativa is a fast growing annual that produces broad, succulent leaves in a rosette around a short stem.

humidity.title: Diseases of Pomegranate (Punica granatum) in Florida
humidity.excerpt: Florida's humid subtropical to tropical climate is favorable for pomegranate establishment but also several diseases; wet and humid periods favor anthracnose.
humidity.rationale: Establishment in humid climate plus substantial humidity/wetness disease pressure -> conservative medium.

humidity.title: Prevent, protect zinnias from powdery mildew
humidity.excerpt: As summer temperatures rise and humidity increases, growers may see powdery mildew; the fungus can compromise photosynthesis and plant development.
humidity.rationale: Species-level humidity-associated disease pressure -> conservative medium.

morphology.title: Zinnia Plant Identification Learning Module
morphology.excerpt: Zinnias are an erect, stiff-stemmed, herbaceous annual.
